mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_audit ( product_id, merchant_id, audit_status, audit_reason, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditReason}, #{auditorId}, #{auditorName}, #{auditTime}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT pa.id, pa.product_id, p.name as product_name, pa.merchant_id, a.username as merchant_name, pa.audit_status, pa.audit_reason, pa.auditor_id, pa.auditor_name, pa.audit_time FROM product_audit pa LEFT JOIN product p ON pa.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN admin a ON pa.merchant_id = a.id WHERE pa.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY pa.audit_time DESC

SELECT pa.id, pa.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS productImage, p.price AS productPrice, p.stock AS productStock, c.name AS categoryName, pa.merchant_id AS merchantId, a.nickname AS merchantName, pa.audit_status AS auditStatus, pa.audit_reason AS auditReason, pa.auditor_id AS auditorId, pa.auditor_name AS auditorName, pa.audit_time AS auditTime, p.create_time AS submitTime, pa.create_time AS createTime FROM product_audit pa LEFT JOIN product p ON pa.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN admin a ON pa.merchant_id = a.id LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE pa.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY pa.audit_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
